items.title: You Got the Wrong Guy
items.description: Fifteen years ago, Leo fell into a spatial rift. Now an amnesiac gray-robed apprentice, he condenses a Primal Core for girlfriend Mia. She betrays him with Vincent, claiming it as theirs. At the gala, Leo exposes them but is attacked. Alexander saves him, revealing himself as Leo's father. Mia and Vincent are banished.

items.title: [Dubbed]Dragon Lord’s Revenge
items.description: To protect Yara and Nora, Ethan Yates clashes with the River Family, the Ward Family, and the Azure Dragon Guild, revealing a power no one expected. As family grudges, school scandals, corporate battles, and a kidnapping unfold, Ethan's true identity and Yara's hidden past become the greatest threats.

items.title: She Swiped the Wrong Dragon Card
items.description: Before leaving for Europe, Seraphina Draven gave her daughter Elena the Obsidian Hoard Card, a symbol of House Draven’s wealth and heirship. But when Seraphina returned, Elena was starving in a hospital bed, unable to pay her bill. Her Obsidian Hoard Card was robbed by her fake sister. Mrs. Draven revenged for her daughter.

items.title: [Dubbed]The Golden Fortress
items.description: In a world on the edge, the Golden Fortress become the stage for power and survival. Soulbearers rise, mutant beasts roam, and Cores hold the key to strength. Loyalty, strategy, and courage define who prevails.

items.title: The Banished Heir's Imperial Blade
items.description: A modern wage slave dies from overwork and wakes up in ancient times as Crownhaven's most hated playboy. His father disowns him and ships him to the frontier as a lowly Warden. But this time, he's not playing nice. He curses out his boss on day one, takes down corrupt officials, exposes secret cults, and catches the eye of a foreign princess. From cannon fodder to Imperial Commander, Damon Ashford carves his own path with every blade he draws.

items.title: I Helped My Husband’s Brother Take The Mafia Throne
items.description: A reborn mafia wife was drowned by her husband for ruining his first love’s birthday. This time, she lets him blow the entire godfather throne for his sweetheart, then strikes a deal with his exiled brother to take everything. Savage karma, brutal payback, no mercy.

items.title: DOWngrade My Ride?I'll Upgrade My Groom!
items.description: On her wedding day, Eleanor Vance expects to step into the bridal Rolls-Royce. Instead, her fiancé Julian orders her into a cramped backup SUV so his “carsick” secretary Sophia can ride beside him. Humiliated in front of guests and filmed by jealous coworkers, Eleanor refuses to break. When a staged car accident keeps her from the ceremony, Sophia steals her gown, her aisle, and Julian’s kiss. But Eleanor has one card left: Christian Thorne, her childhood best friend and the powerful heir who has loved her for years. Within an hour, Eleanor and Christian are legally married. Then they return to the reception with a marriage certificate and a smile. Julian thinks he can still control the bride he discarded. He has no idea she is done begging for respect. This time, Eleanor is upgrading more than her ride—she is upgrading her whole life forever, and destroying his empire too.

items.title: Betrayed God of Olympus
items.description: Leandros saved the world—then his own brother stabbed him in the back, stole the credit, and made everyone believe he was a coward. For a thousand years, he knelt in chains while his best girl married the traitor and his own daughter cursed his name. When the truth finally came out, no one listened—they crushed his soul instead. Big mistake. Because breaking his seal woke something worse than any Titan. Now the gods are begging, and the forgotten hero isn't coming back.

items.title: Secret Dragon
items.description: Iso, the Hidden Dragon Dominion’s supreme ruler, hides as an ordinary man to investigate his mother’s murder. He becomes the fiancé of Sera, who worships the legendary Dragon Lord but scorns her unremarkable betrothed. Cardinal Taren plots repeated assassinations with Dragon Slayers, each time Iso secretly saves Sera with his silver-dragon power—yet she never recognises him. At the final banquet, Iso summons a thousand dragons, revealing his true identity. Only then does Sera realise that the “ordinary” man beside her is the hero she adored. Together, they expose the Church’s conspiracy and uncover the truth of the past.

items.title: [Dubbed]The Martial God’s Return: Rise of the Hidden One
items.description: Richard Ellsworth's appearance sparks conflict. Ian Barton's father's identity is revealed. True and false Richard Ellsworth create chaos, seals weaken, and emotions between Ian Barton and Lillian Harrington become complicated. Factions negotiate over the city's defense and otherworldly demon plots.

items.title: [Dubbed]Destiny's Keeper
items.description: He was clearly the strongest man in the world, yet he was mistaken for a beggar

items.title: [Dubbed] Afterlife: The Zombie Commander
items.description: After death, Alan Scott leads a zombie revolt, triggering a nuclear winter. Amidst rising conflict, he defends Earth against the alien Poetic Civilization, empowered by the planet's consciousness, Gaia. Victorious, humanity now prepares for a cosmic counteroffensive. What awaits them in the depths of space?

items.title: Loved Twice by the Hockey Star
items.description: Seven years after vanishing with his unborn child, Hazel retuirns under a new identity, struggling to save her sick daughter. Alexander, the hockey supersttar who never stopped searching for the woman he lost, has no idea the little girl calling hhim "Daddy" is his own. As buried secrets resurface and old wounds reopen, can love survivethe truth-or is it already too late?

items.title: [Dubbed] Became the Phantom King
items.description: Miles Avery uses a system to overcome loan crises, acquire companies, and complete mysterious tasks. Through financial maneuvering, he brings down Phantom Loan, leading to Mr. Gravemore's downfall and rising as a new power in Sunridge. After facing betrayal, Avery allies with Director Prescott and General Sinclair to challenge the city’s ruling powers, setting the stage for a final showdown over control of Sunridge.

items.title: Medical Genius Is Not Someone to Mess with
items.description: After sacrificing her career for her family, Grace discovered her husband Raymond's affair with Vanessa and their love child. Forced into a destitute divorce, she made a triumphant return to medicine, becoming the renowned director of Apollo Medical Centre. When Raymond's son, Julian, was admitted with a critical aortic aneurysm, Grace agreed to operate despite their abuse. Raymond's family, distrustful of her skills, harassed her and permanently injured her gifted surgical hand. This prevented the life-saving surgery, leading to Julian's death. Even afterwards, the family continued their torment. During a confrontation at a formal dinner, a shocking truth emerged: Julian was not Raymond's biological son!

items.title: Genius Dragon Rider
items.description: In the Northern Sea, two schools coexist—the sacred covenant of equal human-dragon bonds and the corrupt art that enslaves dragons. Four-time champion Kaelen was betrayed by his junior Lovell and the Elder Council; his Moonlight Spirit Dragon Frost shattered into pieces, and Kaelen fell. His remnant soul was reborn as Ailan, a "cursed" outcast boy, who swore to gather the fragments, seek revenge, and restore order.

items.title: The Heiress and the Tailor King
items.description: Isabella, CEO of a fashion empire, was sabotaged at her show. Tailor Luca saved her onstage and restyled her outfit. She resolved to have him.

items.title: Forbidden Stepdad: Claimed by the Demon Prince
items.description: Fallen angel Ezreal descends to Hell for revenge. Bought by demon prince Xavier, their dangerous alliance turns into a forbidden bond sealed by a blood oath. They steal command seals, search for the lost Scepter of Light, and expose Heaven's old crime, deciding the fate of both Hell and Heaven.

items.title: My Freeze.Their Tears.No Forgiveness
items.description: Sophie grew up in an orphanage and was adopted by the wealthy Johnson family at the age of six. She spent twelve happy years surrounded by the love of her three brothers and adoptive parents. However, when the Johnsons' biological daughter Camille returned, Sophie went from being the family's treasure to an outcast—misunderstood and hurt. Camille schemed step by step, constantly framing Sophie, and the family chose to believe her.

items.title: North Dragon Rise After Rejection
items.description: K, a dragonborn, travels to the royal capital with an ancestral contract to wed Princess Isabella. He endures harassment from the queen and mages, foils half-orc and dark elf schemes, joins elf forces to crush the orc army, quells a rebellion, marries the princess, and safeguards the continent's peace.

items.title: The Veteran’s Promise Ⅱ
items.description: After last season, Ridgeline Farm Supply grows into a community pillar. The Malones return, humiliating Sofia's grandfather. The brothers are dragged into war. Gunner is jailed, Connor demands sixty percent of Jack's company. Colonel Frank Morrison is hospitalized, targeted by the family he swore to protect.

items.title: The Foster Son of the Iron Crown
items.description: Ethan, a foster son trampled for fifteen years, secretly holds a bronze ring and a guild. His true father was a legendary commander. When the duke's son tries to poison him, he reveals his power, reforms finances, wins the miners' loyalty, and rebuilds the Dragonspine Legion. The duke's daughter, who once helped him, becomes his ally. He was the true player all along.

items.title: The Mermaid Princess They Betrayed
items.description: Mermaid princess Ella, who senses the Black Tide, is used by the royal family. Betrayed by her fiancé Cedric and pushed into the deadly tide by her sister Vivian, she is saved by pirate king Ronan—the man she once saved. Together they uncover the royal conspiracy. Cedric regrets too late. Ella awakens, commands the tide and pirate fleet, exposes the lies, and rises from pawn to Queen of the Black Tide.

items.title: Revenge of the Forsaken Elf Queen
items.description: Freya Windsor, a half-elf with immense power, hides her brilliance to be an ordinary wife—but her husband Elliott betrays her for Olivia, seizing her wealth and dignity. She trades the Windsor family's military honors for a divorce, dons her armor, and heads to the Misty Swamp battlefield. There, she reveals her genius and exposes Olivia's dark secret—massacring civilians and forging peace treaties.

items.title: The Godfather’s SAT Guide
items.description: Mafia Godfather Vito dies saving abused teen Leo—and awakens in Leo's body. Once a weak outcast, Leo is now inhabited by a sharp, domineering don. He stands up to his cruel family and school bullies, balances secret mafia duties with campus life, and chases his dream of an Ivy League university. He scores a perfect SAT, defeats rival Chris, and finds love with Ella.

items.title: When She Stopped Chasing His Love
items.description: Camilla and her sister Malola study piano. Camilla is gifted but deaf in one ear, so her parents give up on her. Malola is noticed by rich heir Dylan, who sponsors her abroad. Camilla convinces Malola to accept, gaining a chance to learn piano. Three years later, Malola returns, and Camilla has become Dylan's substitute lover. Camilla decides to leave, and producer Cyrus paves her new path. Dylan starts to regret after she leaves.

items.title: Marked by Him I Became the Dragon Clan's Forbidden Toy
items.description: Slayer Stella is betrayed, cursed with dragon blood—dragon prince Silas's soul lives in her heart. She allies with Silas, escapes with elf prince Logan. Grant serves the Void God. Stella and Silas become Dragon Knights, unite three races, destroy the Void God. Stella finds her parents, bonds with Silas—from avenger to guardian.

items.title: Black Blood's Awakening
items.description: Arion Black was prophesied at birth as the "Anti-Magic Vessel"—the final piece to the Demon Lord's conquest. His parents died sealing the Demon Lord and entrusted him to Headmaster White, who abandoned eight-year-old Arion in the slums out of jealousy. Ten years later, the Queen summons all noble heirs back to the Academy. Arion returns, scorned by all—but nobody knows the seal on his power is crumbling. Anti-magic is awakening. And the Demon Lord's prison is cracking open.

items.title: Married to a Fisherman, But He Is Poseidon
items.description: Betrayed and killed by her jealous sister, noble Aloryn is reborn. She casts a silver token into the sea to choose her husband, and Poseidon, disguised as a fisherman, claims it.Despite mockery, Aloryn marries him. Her sister and the arrogant prince torment her, forcing her to walk over burning embers. Enraged, Poseidon reveals his divine identity and punishes the villains.Poseidon’s mother Rhea subjects Aloryn to cruel trials.

items.title: Don't Provoke Him，He’s the King of L.A
items.description: Kane Morgan, founder of Vertex Capital, retired to drive a ride-hailing service to watch over his son Liam after losing his eldest son. Liam is humiliated and kidnapped. Kane reveals his power, returns to his company, and destroys the O'Hara empire. Liam reconciles with his father and finds love with Aurora.

items.title: [Dubbed]The Invincible Bodyguard
items.description: Logan Fraser, as Anna Sutton's bodyguard, protects her company and the Heaven's Medicine project while uncovering his true identity and seeking vengeance. Anna's breakthrough with the medicine sparks fierce competition among rival families, leading to a blend of corporate battles, combat, and family feuds.

items.title: Wrath of the Dragon God
items.description: Twenty years after the Battle of the World Tree, former Dragon God Nidhogg abandons his divinity and hides in Skyfire City to live a quiet life with his daughter Fennica. Fennica is forced into an arranged marriage with Joss, who covets her pure dragon bloodline. He repeatedly drains her blood and threatens to kill her father to silence her. On their wedding day, Joss siphons all her dragon blood, leaving her trapped in a deathlike slumber.

items.title: The Empire Ordered My Death I Ordered Its Collapse
items.description: Declan Aron is transported to Dieso and serves the country loyally for years, but the misguided empress sends him on a suiside mission. In the nick of time, he awakens the Recruitment System and comes to regard Dieso as a game. He summons players from Azure. With his chaotic army, he rebels against authority and fights off invaders, striving to restore the nation.

items.title: In Love With My Ex's Father
items.description: To get over her cheating ex-boyfriend, the jerk Andre, Clarissa picked up and kissed Gabriel in the bar. Only after she sobered up did Clarissa realize that Gabriel was not only her boss but also Andre's father. However, Gabriel fell head over heels for Clarissa at first sight and launched a passionate pursuit of her.

items.title: Seduced by My Childhood Sweetheart
items.description: Senna, an optimistic and strong girl, living with her boyfriend and her bestie, got the internship opportunity of James Group, top dog of the industry. Everything seemed very happy. But one day, Klaus, Senna's childhood neighbor, showed up at her house and stumbled on Senna's boyfriend's affair with her best friend. Senna treated Klaus like a child, but didn’t realize that the so-called child is a hunter disguised as a prey, and gradually encroached on her territory.

items.title: Coaching My Bad Boy Roommate
items.description: Falling for the coach wasn't in the contract. Breaking her heart was his plan—until it backfired.

items.title: Haunted Into Power Ghosts Attack I Level Up
items.description: Fred Carson is a broke office worker, earning barely enough to survive. When a ghost attacks him, he awakens the Ghost Attack System. The more he is attacked...

items.title: The Lost Heiress
items.description: Mia grew up in the slums, raised by her grandmother Mrs. Gray. After her grandmother died, she worked as a design intern, resilient and never complaining. Meanwhile, Olivia, the Winston family's fake daughter, was pampered and arrogant—seemingly kind but deeply jealous and manipulative.

items.title: Billionaire Daddy S Sugar Baby
items.description: Struggling to pay her mother's crushing medical bills, Bella takes a desperate job as a sugar baby—only to discover her mysterious match is Killian, the powerful billionaire she once fled from in fear. As their arrangement turns into real feelings, jealous rival June schemes to expose and destroy Bella. Torn between love and his own rules, Killian pushes Bella away—until both must decide whether risking everything is worth a chance at true love.

items.title: Fated To My Ruthless Alpha
items.description: Seven years after a drugged night left maid Elena wolf-less and pregnant, she regains her wolf only to learn her mate is her cruel oppressor, Alpha Matthew. He cruelly rejects her, trading her to the notoriously savage Alpha Harrison. But Elena soon discovers a divine twist: Harrison isn't a monster. He is her destined second-chance mate and her son Lucas's true biological father—a perfect redemption orchestrated by the Moon Goddess.

items.title: Run Into The CEO's Secret Playroom
items.description: When intern Mila accidentally stumbles into CEO Leo's secret playroom, she is drawn into a dangerous and seductive game of forbidden desire. As power, lust, and family ethics collide, their hidden office affair threatens to unravel into public scandal. Can they break free from the shadows and confront their true feelings when everything is exposed?

items.title: Fortress Home
items.description: Sophia is reborn shortly before a global zombie apocalypse and prepares by stockpiling food, medicine, and survival supplies. Together with her parents, she fortifies their apartment and builds alliances with nearby survivors. Using intelligence and teamwork, they survive both zombies and raiders until rescue forces arrive and restore order.

items.title: My Forced Alpha Mate
items.description: Isabella, a lowly Omega, is sold by her greedy family as a bargaining chip to Blake—the notorious "Tyrant Wolf" and top Alpha—becoming his contract mate. Cold wedding night, family betrayal, wolf pack rejection—she's trapped in despair. But during a deadly attack, she awakens her sealed Moon Wolf bloodline.

items.title: Brother S Rival My Secret Lover
items.description: Kind-hearted Cha Eunhye transfers to the city. Her older brother warns her to stay away from bad men, especially rich and handsome ones like his rival, Bak Seonghun. She swears to stay away, but as she is a novice in romance, she struggles to resist his charm. Meanwhile, he's intrigued that she seems immune to him.

items.title: After Divorce I Built A Fabulous Life
items.description: Once a talented designer, Mia married Tyler for love and became a housewife post-graduation. However, a three-year marriage ended with a divorce decree. Tyler's heartlessness makes Mia give up hope, leading her to reclaim her beloved career. Eventually, Mia shines in her passion, and Tyler realizes his true feelings, allowing them to rediscover love...

items.title: Mafia Single Daddy's Stolen Bride
items.description: On her wedding day, Lucia catches her fiancé cheating—only to be sold to ruthless mafia boss Nico Romano to pay off a gambling debt. Forced into a one-year contract marriage with Nico, she becomes nanny to his traumatized young niece and gradually uncovers the caring man hidden beneath his cold, dangerous facade. But as enemies close in and their forbidden attraction deepens, Lucia must decide whether trusting a mafia boss is worth risking her heart—and her life.

Luna Monroe's hatred has gradually degenerated into a forbidden emotion. ......

items.title: Forever Love Against All Odds
items.description: Upon learning that her severely injured boyfriend, Eugene Joyner, left his wealthy family for her, pregnant Tessa Sutton walks away—allowing him to receive treatment and have his debts settled. After Tessa is involved in a car accident, Eugene is set up to marry someone else, unaware that she survived and even gave birth to their child. When will they meet again, and will the truth finally be revealed?

items.title: The Ceo's Secret Lover
items.description: One night, LS Corp intern Han Ji Eun gets drunk and has a one-night stand with the company's CEO, Bae Seo Jun. She flees in panic but accidentally leaves behind her friend Oh Yun Ju's resume. Seizing the opportunity, Yun Ju takes her place to stay by Seo Jun's side, while Ji Eun becomes his secretary due to her plain appearance. As Seo Jun grows suspicious, Yun Ju schemes against Ji Eun to keep the secret hidden.

items.title: No Taste for Blood
items.description: Althia, fleeing her captors, falls into the arms of Duke Sylvester—the vampire she saved with her blood a decade ago. Her blood heals and revives, but the Vampire Tribunal hunts her. She uncovers a mastermind who knows her fate. Is she just a chess piece, or the one who will overturn the board?

items.title: Blood Harvest
items.description: Former elite CIA agent Morrison, crippled by PTSD, lives anonymously as a small-town farmer with his teen daughter Vivian. Grief-stricken, Morrison stops his PTSD meds, digs up his decade-hidden weapons, and marches alone to the Rosetti estate for revenge. Top cops, city officials and CIA brass remember his deadly combat skills. They order a full town evacuation and step back, letting him annihilate the whole syndicate. This brutal blood-for-blood vendetta explores paternal love, trauma, systemic corruption and unhinged vengeance, blending past wartime ghosts with present ruin to depict an inevitable, merciless reckoning.

items.description: Cody thought he was doing his "retired" father a favor by getting him a low-key job as a security guard.
